Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the reason name for a change in working hours; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Changing hours changes FTE, and usually salary. Do both in one transaction through Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Use this whenAn employee's scheduled hours or FTE change.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

  • The approval or agreement for the change Attach

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • You are in Change Assignment with Salary selected, so hours and pay change together.
  • Working hours hold the new weekly hours. Standard working hours stay at 40.
  • FTE recalculated as expected (for example, 30 of 40 = 0.75).
  • Salary is prorated, or the agreed amount is entered.

Cutoff

Monthly (exempt) pay: the change must be fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff, the 18th in most months and earlier in December. Check the HR/Payroll Calendar. Pending approvals do not pay. A change still waiting in approvals at the cutoff misses that payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Payroll pays the new salary from the effective date.

Watch-outs

  • Change Salary with the reason Change in working hours changes only the salary. The hours still need their own transaction, so prefer Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood employment pages incl. Change Assignment and Change Working Hours (26C) (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Full-time 40 hours goes to 30. What's the FTE?

Q2Why select Salary in the same transaction?

Q3The employee keeps the same salary at fewer hours. What do you do?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.

HCM Academy job aid · Assignment Changes

Change Working Hours

Use when: An employee's scheduled hours or FTE change. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Employment Info and choose Change Assignment.
  2. Effective date, action Assignment change, and reason.
  3. Change Working hours.
  4. Check the salary.
  5. Add comments and attachments, then Submit.

Before you submit

  • Attach: The approval or agreement for the change (attach).
  • Check: You are in Change Assignment with Salary selected, so hours and pay change together. Working hours hold the new weekly hours. Standard working hours stay at 40. FTE recalculated as expected (for example, 30 of 40 = 0.75). Salary is prorated, or the agreed amount is entered.
  • Cutoff: Fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff (the 18th in most months, earlier in December). Pending approvals do not pay.

Watch-outs

  • Change Salary with the reason Change in working hours changes only the salary. The hours still need their own transaction, so prefer Change Assignment with Salary selected.
